problem.label: WHY OUTDOOR COOLING IN QATAR
problem.headline: From May to October, Qatar's heat pushes people indoors.
problem.p1: With summer temperatures regularly exceeding 45°C, outdoor terraces, pool decks, gardens, and commercial seating areas become unusable for almost half the year.
problem.p2: For villa owners, that means five months of an empty garden. For restaurant operators, it means five months of lost covers. For hotels, it means closed pool decks when guests need them most.
problem.p3: High-pressure misting changes that. By atomising water at up to 70 bar, our Italian-engineered systems drop ambient temperatures by 10–15°C instantly — without wetting surfaces, furniture, or your guests.

benefits.b1Body: Flash evaporation at 60–70 bar drops ambient air temperature instantly. Independently verified in Gulf climates — not a lab figure.

faq.q1: Will the mist wet my guests, furniture, or food?

hero.label: INDUSTRIAL & ADIABATIC
hero.sub: At 45°C ambient, Qatar's air-cooled chillers run at 60–70% efficiency. Idrobase adiabatic pre-cooling systems restore capacity and cut energy bills — with no chiller modification required.

technical.label: THE TECHNICAL CASE
technical.headline: Pre-cool the inlet air. Recover the capacity.
technical.body: Air-cooled chillers and dry coolers reject heat to ambient air. In Qatar's peak summer (45–50°C), the chiller has to work substantially harder to reject the same heat load — consuming more energy and producing less cooling capacity. Idrobase's Fog Adiabatico system pre-cools the air entering the condenser coil by atomising fine water mist in front of the coil face. As the water evaporates, it absorbs latent heat and drops the incoming air temperature by 8–15°C.
technical.r5: No modification to existing chiller required
technical.r6: Typical installation: 1–2 days per chiller bank

range.label: KIT RANGE
range.headline: Fog Adiabatico — packaged kits
range.footnote: All systems include AISI 303 stainless steel distribution pipe, polyamide high-pressure pipe (100 bar rated), slip-lock connections, UV sterilizer, water inlet kit and pressure stabilizer.

hero.label: COOL ROOF & SURFACE COATINGS
hero.headline: Stop the Heat Before It Enters.
hero.sub: Nano-ceramic reflective coatings that reduce your roof surface temperature by 15–20°C — lowering your AC load, your electricity bill, and the heat radiating into every room below.

problem.label: THE PROBLEM
problem.headline: Your roof is absorbing 90% of Qatar's sun right now.
problem.body: An uncoated dark roof or metal sheet in Qatar summer reaches 75–80°C surface temperature. That heat conducts downward into occupied spaces and radiates upward, creating a heat dome above every outdoor area adjacent to that surface. Standard AC systems are sized to overcome this heat load — which means they run harder, consume more electricity, and age faster when roofs are uncoated.

how.label: HOW IT WORKS
how.headline: Three steps. Lasting results.
how.s1Body: Nano-ceramic water-based coating sprayed or rolled onto clean roof surface. Compatible with concrete, metal, tiles, and bitumen membrane.
how.s2Body: Ceramic particles reflect up to 90% of solar radiation instead of absorbing it. Surface temperature drops 15–20°C within hours of application.
how.s3Body: Single application lasts 5–7 years in Qatar climate. UV stable. Waterproof. No maintenance required in the lifespan.

apps.a4: Schools & Healthcare — institutional buildings with high occupancy

pavement.body: The same ceramic technology applies to outdoor paving, pool surrounds, terrace floors, and driveways. hero.headline: Shade Makes It Bearable. Mist Makes It Comfortable.
hero.sub: Shade alone reduces solar radiation but does nothing for the heat already in the air. Mist alone is far more effective with shade overhead. Together, they are a complete outdoor climate system.

why.label: WHY COMBINE
why.headline: The sum is greater than the parts.
why.body: A shade structure without misting keeps direct sun off but ambient temperature under the canopy can still reach 38–40°C on a July afternoon. A misting system without shade works harder to cool air that is constantly being heated by direct solar gain. Combined: shade cuts the solar input, misting cools the shaded air. Field data from comparable GCC installations shows combined shade-and-misting delivers 12–18°C reduction from open ambient — compared to 5–10°C for either solution alone.
why.note: Fabtech designs both elements together and installs through one contract.

hero.headline: Keep Your People Cool Too.
hero.sub: Qatar's summer heat is not only a guest experience problem — it is a workforce safety challenge. Fabtech supplies PCM cooling vests, jackets, and accessories for any team working in outdoor conditions.

regulation.label: THE REGULATORY CONTEXT
regulation.headline: Qatar's outdoor work regulations — what you need to know.
regulation.body: Qatar's Ministry of Labour prohibits outdoor work between 10:00 AM and 3:30 PM from June 15 to September 15. Outside those hours, outdoor workers still face serious heat exposure risk — particularly during early morning and evening shifts. Employers have a duty of care for workers in outdoor conditions. PCM cooling vests are a recognized heat protection measure and Fabtech can supply them for construction crews, hospitality staff, landscaping teams, facility maintenance personnel, and outdoor event staff.

products.label: PRODUCTS
products.p1Body: Phase Change Material panels inside a lightweight vest. Absorbs body heat and maintains safe skin temperature for 2–4 hours. Recharged by soaking panels in cold water for 20 minutes or placing in a freezer overnight. Sizes S to 3XL. CE marked.
products.p2Body: Full jacket version for workers in high-sun-exposure roles. Shoulder and back PCM panel coverage in addition to front panels. Sizes S to 3XL.
products.p3Body: Lower-cost alternative. Soaked in cold water, worn wet — evaporation provides 2–3 hours of relief. No PCM panels. Best for roles with access to water refill points.
products.p4Body: Neck cooling wraps | Cooling bandanas | Cooling hard hat inserts | Wrist cooling bands

supply.headline: Seasonal Supply Contracts Available
supply.body: Fabtech offers seasonal supply contracts for organisations requiring ongoing cooling vest provision. Minimum order quantities apply. Contact us for bulk supply pricing.

personalCooling.crossSell: For fixed outdoor areas, combine personal cooling vests with a Fabtech misting system to create a complete outdoor work environment solution.

meta.title: Mosquito Control Misting Qatar | Outdoor Insect Repellent System | Fabtech
meta.description: Automated mosquito and insect control misting for Qatar outdoor spaces. Runs through your existing Idrobase cooling system. Dusk-activated. Safe for food service environments.

hero.label: MOSQUITO & INSECT CONTROL MISTING
hero.headline: Stay Outside After Sunset Too.
hero.sub: Qatar evenings bring insects that push guests indoors just as the temperature becomes bearable. Automated insect-control misting keeps your outdoor space usable after dark — through the same system that cools it during the day.

how.label: HOW IT WORKS
how.headline: Same pipes. Same nozzles. Second function.
how.body: Fabtech's mosquito control misting uses the same Idrobase high-pressure pipe network and nozzles as your cooling system — charged with a food-safe, approved insect-repellent concentrate instead of plain water. An automated timer activates the insect-control cycle at dusk — typically 30–60 minutes before evening service begins — and runs at intervals through the evening.
how.note: No separate installation. No aerosol cans. No manual spraying. No chemical odour.

specs.label: SYSTEM SPECS
specs.s1Body: Food-safe approved insect-repellent concentrate. Compatible with stainless steel nozzles and polyamide HP pipe. Approved for use in food service environments.
specs.s2Body: Automated dusk-activation via Fog Extra 2.0 weekly programmer or Var3 Touch zone controller.
specs.s3Body: Same coverage as your cooling system — sized to your outdoor area.
specs.s4Body: Monthly nozzle flush with clean water recommended to prevent concentrate residue buildup.

apps.label: APPLICATIONS
apps.a1: Restaurants and café outdoor terraces — evening dining service
apps.a2: Villa gardens and pool decks — family outdoor evenings
apps.a3: Hotel pool decks and bar terraces — evening F&B service
apps.a5: Event venues and wedding spaces — evening events

disclaimer.label: HONEST NOTE ON EFFECTIVENESS
disclaimer.body: Misted insect-repellent concentrate is effective at reducing insect presence in the treated zone during and immediately after misting cycles. It is not a total elimination solution and effectiveness varies with wind conditions and insect density. We recommend it as part of an overall outdoor comfort system, not as a standalone pest control service. For severe infestation problems, consult a qualified pest control contractor alongside this system.

mosquitoControl.crossSell: Most Fabtech misting installations can be upgraded to include mosquito control at minimal additional cost — the pipework is already in place.
